page.title: Explore
page.purpose: Suggest meals that fit the person's rules, kitchen, and week — each with a visible reason and explicit planning context such as Planning Wednesday dinner — so a new idea becomes a planned meal in one action.

priorities.statement: When opened from a slot, the context banner says what is being planned and each card's primary action targets that slot only.
Every suggestion carries a short reason built from evaluated facts, never fabricated personalization.
Required rules filter candidates before ranking; a candidate that fails them is never offered as fitting.
Only sections with meaningful results appear; an empty one becomes guidance instead of an empty carousel.
Save and Add to the week are idempotent and never silently replace a planned meal.
Creating a meal idea with AI is optional, labelled as a draft, and hidden or explained when unavailable.

states.description: First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
A search or filter matched nothing; the query stays visible and Reset filters is offered.
No candidate satisfies the required rules; the blocking conditions and next actions are named.
Opened from an empty slot; the banner reads Planning Wednesday dinner and cards offer Add to Wednesday.
Opened to swap an existing meal; cards offer Replace Wednesday dinner with an impact preview.
The plan changed while exploring; the slot is revalidated and a refreshed choice is offered instead of an overwrite.
Setup has not been applied; the page says suggestions do not reflect rules that were never entered.
No generation capability is configured; Create a meal idea is hidden or explained.

The rules and equipment that block every candidate, with next actions.
States that suggestions do not reflect unentered rules.
Says the slot changed and offers a refreshed choice.

claims.statement: Opened from a slot, the page names the day and slot being planned.
Add to Wednesday is the dominant card action and targets only the context slot.
When the slot is occupied the action is Replace with an impact preview; Add never replaces silently.
Each suggestion's reason comes from evaluated facts and never claims enough stock or nutrition when data is missing.
When nothing fits the required rules, the blockers are named and no exclusion is weakened.
Before setup, the page makes no claim that suggestions fit.
A concurrent plan change produces a refreshed choice, not an overwrite.
Dismissing the planning banner returns to general discovery and never removes an occurrence.
Save names the meal and says it bookmarks, distinct from the favourite heart.
Create a meal idea is hidden or disabled with an explanation when generation is unavailable, never a dead button.
Cards, their actions, filters, and the banner's dismiss control are keyboard reachable.
On phones suggestions are one card per row with the reason visible.
Secondary collections scroll within their own row with visible continuation; the page never scrolls sideways.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
